pairingRecovery.binding: Existing native CSPRNG one-use inviteId/tokenDigest, both complete DeviceId/instance/certificate pins and platform TLS CertificateVerify bind a unique fixed transcript; no additional nonce roundtrip.
pairingRecovery.commit: One ORIGINAL SQL transaction CASes invitation state/TTL and native confirmation revision/exact scope, stores peer+grant+the complete immutable PairingCompletion in the original invite receipt_json.
pairingRecovery.proof: PairingCommitReceipt uses the standard P256 signed-record format; binds commitId, committedAt, original invite, transcriptDigest, exact receiving grantDigest/grantId/epoch and both complete identities. grantDigest omits only the separately fenced revoked flag.
pairingRecovery.recovery: PairingFinalize purpose=commit|recover; committed recovery is a distinct native 1..30000ms read-only exact-pin mTLS handle. It never extends pending TTL, changes scopes/epochs/expiry, refills budget or dispatches business effects. Replies reuse exact originally stored completion bytes/signatures.
pairingRecovery.joinerReview: Original candidate record_json role=local_offer stores only native owner-reviewed public offer, local signature and exact local scope, never token. A native RecoveryOffer restores only this original review and requires proof of the prior in-TTL remote commit before reciprocal installation.
pairingRecovery.revocation: Current owner revoke, epoch/scope revision, pin/instance change or grant expiry explicitly denies remote executable recovery. Historical immutable commit remains local only and cannot restore active trust.
pairingRecovery.schemaMigration: No new table, column, database, Runner or version; state-specific records reuse original invite receipt_json and candidate record_json.
